notes.title: Notice : Stop the sale
notes.content:
Thanks for those of you who've been enjoying "Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True".

After reviewing princess maker 3 currently on sale,
we have judged that maintenance support is no longer possible.

Unfortunately, "Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True" is going to stop selling.

I ask for your support "Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True (HD Remake)"which is back with the new engine and beautiful graphics.

Thank you

notes.title: Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True Sale Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you very much for always giving a lot of love and interest in "Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True", third work of the masterpiece simulation game Princess Maker series.
We'd like to let you know the new release in order to avoid confusion about game purchases.

HD Remake for Princess Maker 3, "Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True (HD Remake)" will release on December 23, 2019.

"Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True (HD Remake)” has been completely redesigned to match the FHD resolution (1920x1080) while maintaining the original feel and mood. And the attractive illustration of Takami Akai has also been rearranged to high-resolution so that the players can enjoy the game more clearly and pleasantly.

As a new element for the game, the game updated with a new UI. The UI will be able to change freely between the existing version and the new UI in the game. In addition, we've added arranged BGM to help you enjoy in fresh mood. The arranged BGM is also freely changed during the gameplay.

We've added a lot of comfort factors, such as soft movement and support for controllers, to make it more pleasant to play.

The existing "Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True" will be significantly reduced in price to avoid confusing from "Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True (HD Remake)".

In addition, "Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True (HD Remake)" will have a 20% off launch discount.

We will do our best to support the newly released "Princess Maker ~Faery Tales Come True (HD Remake)". We appreciate all your support in our Princess Maker series!

Thank you

notes.title: Issue recovery report
notes.content:
Greetings from CFK support.

It is indeed unfortunate situation to mention but the newly released "Princess Maker 3: Fairy Tales Come True" had some troubles in game execution for some users.

As of now, this issue has been properly solved. However, in case of experiencing same issue still, please follow steps below.

#1. Unistall the game 

#2. Install game to different destination folder.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience might caused to you. 

Please keep us informed on your issue, will try our best efforts to perfect it.

BR
CFK
